Une tournée immersive à travers dix wila: An immersive tour through ten wilayas
Ooredoo Algérie déploie son \"Summer Tou: Ooredoo Algeria is deploying its "Summer Tour 2026" from July 16 to September 8, 2026, across ten coastal wilayas, transforming public spaces into interactive digital villages. This initiative is part of a customer-proximity approach and the promotion of digital usage, combining connectivity, entertainment, and innovation.
La tournée, organisée en partenariat ave: The tour, organized in partnership with Condor and Ifri, features an immersive digital village with video games, demonstrations of Ooredoo services, and interactive activities. Visitors can also discover the operator's offers or benefit from commercial advantages, such as gifts when purchasing top-ups equal to or greater than 500 Algerian dinars or by following Ooredoo Algeria's TikTok page.
